title: My Stepson Forged The Deed And Sold My Home For $320K. So I Made Him Scoop Dog Waste
description: After my husband died, my stepson forged the deed and sold our family home for $320,000, leaving me with nothing but a moving truck. I found a hidden SD card with my husband's video, overturned the sale, and now he works at my kennel, 'Forged Deed Dog Kennel,' shoveling waste in a shirt that says 'Scooped My Inheritance.' Every boarding tag prints the deed fraud docket number. #revenge #karmicjustice #familybetrayal
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY HOME. NOW HE SCOOPS DOG WASTE
pinned_comment: If you found out your stepson forged your signature and sold your home for $320,000, what would you have done? Share your own story in the comments if something similar happened to you.
